Reset terminal controls?

Tap, double tap and long press go back to what they do at first, with the phone\'s own times; the key bar hides with a desk keyboard; C-c sends on a tap. Your keys and key groups stay: Arrange keys has its own Reset.

Reset notifications?
Blocked, failed, done and messages alert again, bells do not, a bell on screen vibrates, and progress bars are off. Background mode and each host\'s and tailnet\'s page stay as they are.
